title: Russian Fuel Crisis Tracker Update — Fri Sep 18, 2026

The update also folds in the second Saratov strike (Sept 11), the Slavyansk-on-Kuban/Taneco strikes (Sept 13), and the Syzran refinery's total loss of distillation capacity plus Reuters' finding that three of Russia's six largest diesel refineries are now halted or curtailed (Sept 15).
